notes.title: かぞえ飯Ver1.0.7Auto save and other bug fixes
notes.notes:
Automatic save function implemented.
　The game is now automatically saved every three minutes.

Fixed a bug in some skills.
　Fixed a bug that caused rice to float in the air and not be able to be moved when a remote catch was activated while the rice was already being picked up.

Fixed a bug that caused the camera to move when the rice was cleared.
　The camera position is now reset to default when the number of rice is answered correctly.
